recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. Re-adding valueMarkdown for Observation.value[x] or Observation.component.value[x] would reverse a later Published OO decision and should only happen through a new work-group-approved tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-39654 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 asking to change DiagnosticReport.conclusion to markdown, change Observation.referenceRange.text to markdown if normative rules allowed it, and add markdown as a choice type for Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x].
initial_application: The R5 implementation history shows commit 9c366e6106 changed DiagnosticReport.conclusion, Observation.referenceRange.text, Observation.value[x], and Observation.component.value[x] from string to markdown, and commit 8aaaf4a45c updated related examples/search material on the FHIR-39654 branch. DiagnosticReport.conclusion was also independently accepted in FHIR-39570.
additional_context: FHIR-40560 was later Published/Persuasive with Modification and directed the spec to restore Observation valueString, remove valueMarkdown, remove canonical(), and apply the same value/component changes to both Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x]. Zulip discussion and the 2023-03-06 OO minutes record the normative compatibility rationale. FHIR-41002 and FHIR-45339 then cleaned up invalid Observation search parameters left by the brief valueMarkdown/canonical state.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The combined branch source has DiagnosticReport.conclusion and Observation.referenceRange.text as markdown, while Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x] use string rather than markdown in accordance with the later FHIR-40560 decision.
